environment.description: Deployed on EKS 1.28 with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Pod runs in namespace 'media-processing' with a PodSecurity admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile (runAsNonRoot, drop ALL capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem with emptyDir for /var/lib/app/conversions and /tmp). The node runs a Falco daemonset with custom rule macro that triggers alert+kill on any process spawned by 'convert' that is not in the set {convert, gs, decode}. Additionally, the container image bundles a custom /etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml that sets: <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="MSL" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="TEXT" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="SHOW" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="WIN" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="EPHEMERAL" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="URL" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="MVG" />, <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="SVG" />, and <policy domain="delegate" rights="none" pattern="*" />. The delegate policy disabling means ImageMagick cannot invoke any external programs (no shell delegates). Network policy applied to the namespace blocks all egress except DNS (UDP 53) to kube-dns and TCP 443 to the internal registry.

config.imagemagick_policy: custom: delegates disabled, dangerous coders (MSL/MVG/SVG/URL/TEXT/SHOW/EPHEMERAL) set to rights=none
config.falco_rule: kill process if parent is 'convert' and child not in {convert,gs,decode}
